_comment: Tests that are red for a reason already known and owned. Reported, not fatal.
EVERY entry has an expiry. A permanent exception is a deleted test with extra steps.
run_tests.py exits 2 when an entry passes or goes past its date, because a stale
exception hides the next real break the same way the floor-of-21 did.
Membership is measured, not guessed: an entry is here because the run actually
emitted the board_ingest SyntaxError, which catches indirect importers
(action_executor, owner_pin) that a grep for 'import board_ingest' misses.
Do not add an entry to make CI quiet. Add it when someone owns the fix and dated it.

expected_failures.why: cascade: board_ingest.py does not parse on main (0759ccf, U+2026 at line 1450). GPT owns the repair; these go green with it.
